body: the dish cloth and folded road map are tied with cut warning tape. six tally cuts mark the dish cloth; only four are crossed through.
title: Dish cloth with the unclosed tally
gloss: A response bundle preserves a missing count, changed route, or erased identity.
rival_reading: A farm-program crew could have counted routes, repacked tools, or removed ownership marks during hurried field work; the objects do not prove a concealed public response.

body:
Leave the canisters outside the fence until the grounds crew finishes the test. The gate was already locked when the delivery arrived; the return form charges us for the missing seal.

We waited for a correction that never came. Every passing driver had a different instruction and no room for one more passenger.

I could have mistaken the order in which those things happened. I could not mistake the empty place left for the person we had been waiting for.
title: The drawer copy survived
gloss: A grounds test and a locked gate leave a delivery outside its expected handoff.
rival_reading: Emergency crews could have restricted access and returned sealed containers; the note does not say what was inside.
